dataset_structure.target_repetition: every unique target repeats exactly 12 times

training_evidence.interpretation: The row-random dev split is structurally leaked by task/context/target groups, so the lower eval loss is not independent generalization evidence.

observations: V1 repeated <CODE> on cpp_even and cpp_reverse.
Stage2 fixed cpp_even but still repeated <CODE> on cpp_reverse.
Stage2 c_strlen answer was not a valid implementation and was semantically confused.
Stage2 cpp_sum returned prose rather than the requested function.
Base produced more directly usable code on several of the six smoke prompts.

proven: template/group leakage in the dev split
assistant targets are universally prefixed with <CODE>
generation collapse exists on OOD-style prompts
inferred: format overfitting contributes to the collapse
the leaked dev loss materially overstates generalization
unknown: the exact optimizer/token-level mechanism causing repeated <CODE> generation

claim_boundary: Dataset design defects and live failures are verified. Causal attribution to one internal mechanism remains unproven.
